title: Quantization (LLM)
description: Documented public model compression method (research community) for the Model Compression Engine capability area.
body:
Quantization (LLM) is a documented model compression method from research community. Reducing weight precision (INT8/INT4) to shrink models 2-4× with minimal quality loss — the key to local LLM deployment.

How it works: It works by combining the sparsity ratio with the bit-width reduction to compute the compressed size and compression ratio.

Documented uses of this capability area include neural architecture search, automated hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation leaderboards, and AI safety red-teaming.
